outline: This course is designed as an intensive teacher training program for students to become effective EFL teachers. Students are required to do the microteaching and present some selected chapters from the textbooks.
schedule:
A detailed syllabus will be distributed on the first day of class.
W1. Course Introduction
W2. Testing & Assessment Design
W3. Invited Talk: Flipped Classroom & Mobile Learning
W4. Classroom Observation
W5. Teaching Demonstration (1)
W6. Teaching Demonstration (2)
W7. Teaching Demonstration (3)
W8. Teaching Demonstration (4)
W9. Midterm
W10. Teaching Internship (1)
W11. Teaching Internship (2)
W12. Teaching Internship (3)
W13. Teaching Internship (4)
W14. Multicultural & International Education
W15. Lesson Planning & Essay Writing Practice
W16. Textbooks and Materials Evaluation/ Portfolio
W17. Mock Interview & Teaching Demo
W18. Final
assessment:
Teaching Demonstration + Lesson Plans (drafts & revision): 30%
Teaching Intern & Report (classroom observantion/reflections/teaching video): 30%
Game Design (5-min teaching demo): 15%
Mock Interview & Portfolio (CV, biography, teaching philosophy, teaching materials, etc.): 15%
Attendance and Participation: 10%
